provenance: User-supplied manual observations, not formal benchmark measurements
observations: FireRed generally performs outfit changes, reclothing, body morphing, and similar existing-canvas edits well.
Informal failure rate roughly one in four, primarily incomplete instruction adherence.
This is not a formal benchmark pass rate.
FireRed outpainting is unreliable; it may compress or distort visible limbs to satisfy additions inside the existing canvas instead of extending it correctly.
Do not use FireRed as the preferred outpainting backend.
benchmark_purpose: Validate reproducible API behavior for manually observed capabilities; not exploratory proof that FireRed can edit clothing.
